scope_and_limitations: Offline perception only: nothing is connected to control; motion/grasp/place in zone runs is still the teacher executor. Not an RGB-skill or delivery success.
Synthetic re-posing (teleport + 0.3 s settle), fixed lighting, fixed paint, one camera resolution (960x720); no motion blur, no held box, no real-camera noise.
Own-RGB positions use the commanded arm pose; far_coarse (>1.2 m) range is biased long (~+21%, median +0.4 m) while bearing is accurate (dev median 0.17 deg).
Colour gives kind only; boxes of one colour are not individually identified.
dispatch/open is a beam-confusion appendix only; top_zone_v2 is not meant for the dispatch map (yellow apron paint FPs).
